# Splitnir the Storming

Internal ID: SpearSplitner_Lightning | Type: Spear | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x18, Iolite x3 | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Hitbox: 1.9 range, 40 angle, 1.5 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Splitnir the Storming is the upgraded form of Splitnir using Iolite. Like all weapons made with Iolite, it gains 10 lightning damage and a 25% chance to apply Chain Lightning on hit.
Upgrading a Splitnir to Splitnir the Storming will always result in a quality 1 weapon, regardless of the original weapon's quality.
